verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Postman uses a portable 'Postman Collection format' for organizing API requests (postman-docs-16) and community comments reference exporting/importing collections as JSON data (postman-comm-14, postman-comm-16), but there is no first-party documentation directly describing an import/export UI, supported formats (e.g., OpenAPI, cURL), or cross-tool compatibility guarantees. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on the import/export feature, list of supported portable formats, and independent confirmation of successful round-tripping between Postman and other API tools.
